about.title: About
about.description: About   I am a product-focused {{ROLE}} based in Bangalore, India, experienced in building enterprise applications using Frappe, ERPNext, Python, and REST APIs. Skilled in workflow automation, financial system development, backend API design, and scalable search implementation using Amazon OpenSearch. Comfortable owning features end-to-end, collaborating with product and design teams at {{CURRENT_COMPANY}}, and shipping production-ready systems used by active users.

technical_approach.title: TECHNICAL APPROACH
technical_approach.description: I specialize in building robust, performant backends and automating business workflows. My work focuses on translating complex business requirements into clean, reliable, and performant technical solutions, from loan recovery platforms to procurement systems and ODR platforms.

education.title: Education
items: B.E. Computer Science — Bapuji Institute of Engineering and Technology, Davangere (2020 – 2023) | CGPA: 7.90

items.description: Architecting and building scalable enterprise platforms, financial workflows, and search engines using Frappe, ERPNext, Python, REST APIs, and Amazon OpenSearch.
highlights: Engineered Integro — a financial loan recovery platform managing recovery workflows, custom DocTypes, and automated stage transition scripts.
Integrated Amazon OpenSearch for sub-second search and multi-attribute data filtering over large financial datasets.
Developed Procure-to-Pay (P2P) & Concurrent Audit system for Quess Corp with customized ERPNext procurement workflows.
Configured Frappe ERPNext v16 Chart of Accounts & financial ledger for adrEdge Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform.
Automated nightly ETL data ingestion pipelines using Apache Airflow & REST API sync.
